correctness.rationale: The dual is precisely the complex with no disconnected induced four-subset. Enumeration via the geometric cuboctahedron independently found 126 connected four-sets, 24 five-faces, no higher dual faces, and the stated primal face vector. Independently replayed all 132 supplied pairs in cube-edge labels, requiring a unique proper coface at each deletion; the residual face vector is (12,60,112). A separate greedy collapse in geometric labels reduced the dual to (12,66,118) in 126 moves, also of reduced Euler characteristic 63. The original dual's complete two-skeleton makes it simply connected, so its collapsed two-complex has free H2 of rank 63 and is a wedge of 63 two-spheres by Hurewicz and homological Whitehead. Integral Alexander duality on 12 labels puts its cohomology in primal homology degree 12-2-3=7. The primal full five-skeleton gives 4-connectivity, and Hurewicz with vanishing H5 and H6 gives 6-connectivity. An integral basis represented by seven-spheres then gives the claimed wedge. Purity follows from the 369 distinct complements, each of size eight.
residual_risks: No shellability or equivariant homotopy assertion is inferred.
